input.text: Customer data must be retained for 7 years.

structuredContent.statement: Customer data must be retained for 7 years.

tool.description: Convert a prose requirement plus optional extracted claim fields into a deterministic strict-lane write set. Read-only modeling returns a sequential applyPlan for later kb_upsert calls. High-confidence claims emit req+fact strict output; lower-confidence claims emit an observation review artifact. Includes migration warnings when legacy schemaVersion metadata is detected.

confidence.description: Confidence score for the extracted claim. >= 0.70 yields strict-lane output; lower confidence yields observation-only review output.

operator.description: Optional extracted semantic claim operator. Example: 'eq'.

propertyKey.description: Optional extracted semantic claim propertyKey. Example: 'Retention Years'.

provenance.description: Optional extracted text reference. Falls back to source when omitted. Example: 'documentation/requirements/customer-retention.md#L1'.

source.description: Optional primary source path or provenance root used for stable IDs and text refs. Example: 'documentation/requirements/customer-retention.md'.

sourceFiles.description: Optional related source files. The first value is used as the source fallback when source is omitted.

subjectKey.description: Optional extracted semantic claim subjectKey. Example: 'Customer.Data'.

text.description: Required prose requirement text to model. Example: 'Customer data must be retained for 7 years.'

value.description: Optional extracted semantic claim value. Accepts string, number, or boolean.

tool.name: kb_model_requirement
